title: Defining Companies

children:
If you process product for one or more companies, you will need to define 
 them in the system. You can define separate items, employees, customers, 
 and other warehouse entities for each company you define in the system. 
 In addition, you can calculate separate rates per company. You can also 
 define which employees can process a company's products, which items and 
 customers should be associated with a specific company, and generate system 
 documentation that includes the company. Note that customers and items 
 can be setup without companies if they are same values are shared by each 
 company.
Detail Window (Ship from Address Tab Fields)
Detail Window (Freight Bill to Address Tab Fields)
Upload Receipt Details With 0 Quantity Received Checkbox
Upload Closed Receipts with 0 Quantity Received Checkbox
Split Consolidate Shipments on Upload Checkbox

Use the UCC/EAN 
 Number Field to provide the UCC/EAN identifier assigned to this 
 company. This number is a unique prefix that identifies this company.

Use the Order 
 ID Prefix Field to indicate the default prefix that the system 
 will add to all orders created for this company in the full screen and 
 web order entry system.

Use the Receipt 
 ID Prefix Field to indicate the default prefix that the system 
 will attach to the beginning of the names of all web receipts created 
 in web receipt entry.

Use the Purchase 
 Order ID Prefix Field to indicate the default prefix that the system 
 will attach to the beginning of the names of all web purchase orders created 
 in Trading Partner Management.

Use the Availability 
 Checking Checkbox to indicate that you want the system to verify 
 if the warehouse contains enough quantity to satisfy a company's new shipment. 
 The system performs this validation when an order is created via order 
 entry, or a new shipment line is entered. The system will alert the 
 user if enough inventory does not exist to meet this demand.

You can use this tab to configure ship from address(es) per warehouse/company combination. If defined, the system will use this address on shipping paperwork. If not defined, then the system will use the company address first, or the warehouse address (if no company address exists). Note that you can only create one address detail record per warehouse/company combination. Also, if the Returns Address and /or Freight Bill To Address tabs are left blank on this detail, then the shipping paperwork will use the values on the Ship From Tab address fields.
Use the Header Fields to define the warehouse/company combination that this address will apply to.
Use the Ship From Address (required), Returns Address, and Freight Bill To Address Tab Fields to define the shipping information for this detail record.
Press OK, and the system will save your warehouse/company detail record and display it in the tab grid.

Use the Address 
 Fields to define the company's general shipping information.

Use these fields 
 to identify where all product shipped for this warehouse will be returned.

Using the Freight Bill To 
 Tab

Use these fields 
 to identify the address where all shipping bills for this company should 
 be sent.

Use these fields 
 to define settings related to the internet.

Use theCenter 
 Graphic Values to indicate the path of the graphic that will appear 
 at the top-center of the Trading Partner Management Main Menu. 
 The path should be in this format:     \\YourServer\Directory1\Directory2\graphic.gif.
For more information on these values, see their field topics:

Use the Center 
 URL Values This field indicates the specific URL of the link that 
 will be associated with the graphic that appears at the top-center of 
 the Trading Partner Management Main Menu. The URL should be in this format:
For more information on these values, see their field topics:

Use these checkboxes 
 to assign employees with this company. Only employees that you select 
 from this tab will be able to process entities for this company.
Use these fields to identify if data should be interfaced for certain process conditions based on the company.
